subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 5:3. If the total quantity of the mixture is 40 liters, how much water is in the mixture?
solution: Total parts = 5 + 3 = 8. Water part = 3/8. Water quantity = (3/8) * 40 = 15 liters. Topic (Mixture and Allegation) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
